chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad from one of his companions from Hammad ibn 'Uthman from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding the Words of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'And let them fulfill their vows and let them go round the Ancient House.' He said: 'The Tawaaf of the women.'
ai.seo_question: What does the Quranic command to 'go round the Ancient House' specifically refer to regarding women's rituals?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies that the command 'let them go round' in Surah Al-Hajj specifically refers to the ritual circumambulation (Tawaaf) performed by women, distinguishing it from other obligations. This narration is foundational in Shia jurisprudence for establishing the validity and specific rulings of women's participation in Hajj rituals, particularly regarding the purity and manner of their Tawaaf. It underscores the Imam's role in elucidating the practical application of Quranic verses to daily religious practice.
